title: Central Sling
description: Lower body and core in two classic blocks: paused lunges and glute bridge then advanced core

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Brisk in-place march
exercises.instructions: March quickly in place with arm swing

exercises.name: Hip 90/90
exercises.instructions: Seated, legs at 90 degrees, rotate from side to side

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.instructions: Hold a deep squat, back straight, elbows against the knees

exercises.name: Paused lunges
exercises.instructions: Lower down and hold 3s at the bottom before rising

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, push hips toward the ceiling

exercises.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
exercises.instructions: On one leg, hinge torso forward, back leg extended

exercises.name: Shoulder tap plank
exercises.instructions: In a high plank, tap opposite shoulder alternating

exercises.name: Scissors
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, legs extended, cross alternating over/under

exercises.name: Bear hold
exercises.instructions: On all fours, knees 2cm off the floor, hold the position

exercises.name: Psoas stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
